game_title: Stack Of Plates – Weathered Gate Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate, a weathered stone gate: the ruin warden must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate: a weathered stone gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Weathered Gate, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about stack_balance to power up the ruin warden and open the relic vault.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against eldritch shades in Weathered Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
